text.body: śrīḥ śrīmānveṅkaṭanāthāryaḥ kavitārkikakesarī | vedāntācāryavaryo me sannidhattāṃ sadā hmadi || śāstrāvatāraḥ svasti śrīraṅgabhartuḥ kimapi dadhadahaṃ śāsanantatprasattyai satyaikālambi bhāṣyaṃ yatipatikathitaṃ śaśvadaddhyāpya yuktān| viśvasminnāmarūpāṇyanuvihitavatā tena devena dattāṃ vedāntācāryasaṃjñāmavahitabahuvitsārthamanvarthayāmi || śrīmadbhyāṃ syādasāvityanupadhi varadācāryarāmānujābhyāṃ samyagdṛṣṭena sarvaṃsahaniśitatadhiyā veṅkaṭeśena klṛptaḥ| sevyosau śāntacittaiḥ śravaṇarasanayā śāntilābhārthibhirvā siddhaśśārīrakārthe sahajabahuguṇaḥ ruāgdharādugdharāśiḥ|| trayyantasvāntavādinyadhikaraṇagaṇe paunaruktyoktabādhau mandatvāsaṅgatatve viśayamaphalatāṃ mānabādhaṃ ca mantṝn| diṅmohakṣobhadīnān dinakarakiraṇaśreṇikevojjihānā hmadyā padyāvalīyaṃ hmadayamadhigatā sāvadhānāndhinotu || gambhīre brāhṛbhāge gaṇayitumakhilaṃ kaḥ pravīṇaḥ prameyaṃ diṅmātraṃ darśayannapyahamiha nipuṇaiḥ prādhvamadhyakṣaṇīyaḥ| mā bhūnniśśeṣasiddhistadapi guṇavidaḥ sphītanissīmaratne madhyehāraṃ nidheyammahati jahati kimmauktikaṃ labdhamabdhau|| vedārthanyāyacintye prathamamadhigataḥ karmavargaḥ pramāṇaiḥ bhedairaṅgaiḥ prayuktyā kramaviracanayā'thādhikṛtyā'tidiṣṭā| tatrāśeṣairviśeṣaistadanu tadanuvatryūhataḥ prāptabādhaiḥ tantreṇātha prasaktyā tata upari caturlakṣaṇī devatārthā|| prāgdharme'lpāsthirārthe praśamitaviśaye tādṛśārādhyayukte'thātaśśārīrakāṃśe bahuvidhamahima brāhṛ mīmāṃsitavyam| kṛtsnasvāddhyāyasāṅgāddhyayanasamuditāpātabuddhyaiva karma tyaktvā''dau brāhṛcintāṃ kimiti na kurutāntanna tulyoktyabādhāt|| prāvaṇyaṃ prāktrivarge saphalayatanatopāsanāṅgatvato'pi vyākhyārūpe'tra śāstre kramaniyatirasau syācca mukhyakrameṇa| mānatvādirvicāryaḥ purata iha tathā vākyavedyātpadārtho dṛṣṭāntaścopameyādyadi madhu savidhe yātu cādiṃra kimarthaḥ|| vyācakhyuḥ ke'pi tāpatrayahatimitare sādhanānāṃ catuṣkaṃ kāṇḍe'smin pūrvavṛttaṃ kathayati nigamaḥ karmacintāphalāntat| sāṅgādhītirhi sūte viśayamavasaraḥ kvātra tantrāntarāderaucityasthāpito'yaṃ krama iha na punaścodanāsaṃprayuktaḥ|| nityaprāptasya kaṇṭhasthitakanakanayānnirviśeṣasya labdhirmithyābhūtaṃ nivatryaṃ śrutiśakalabhuvaḥ prekṣaṇāttannivṛttiḥ| karmaivaṃ kvopayuktaṃ pratibhaṭamapi tadvṛttatoktirmadukte prāptā'treti pralāpe prativacanagatirbhāṣitā vistareṇa|| mīmāṃsāyāḥ kabandhaṃ katicana jagṛhū rāhukalpaṃ śiro'nye kintairantarvirodhapramuṣitamatibhiḥ bāhrakalpaibhrramadbhiḥ | svāddhyāyāddhyāyakātsnye svavidhiparavidhipreraṇā tāvadāstāṃ kṛtsnāpātapratītau kimiti kṛtadhiyaḥ kṛtsnacintānna kuryuḥ|| prādhītasyaikarūpaprayatananiyatādekarūpopakārādvidyāsthānaikyasiddhau kramaniyatiyutākāṅkṣayaikaprabandhyam| addhyāyādiṣvivāvāntaraviṣayaphalādyanyatā'trāpyabhettrī tattulyaḥ kartṛbhedaḥ kalibalakaluṣaiḥ kalpito'rthe virodhaḥ|| tattadvaiśiṣṭabhedādyadagaṇi bhidurā devatā pūrvabhāge saṃjñāvaiṣamyamātrādapi kathamiyatā'dhītayaṣṭavyabhaṅgaḥ| uddeśyākārabhedo'styayamiha haviṣāmuktibhinne prayoge daurbalyaṃ tvakṣavedyānmiticaramatayā dravyato devatāyāḥ|| jaiminyuktaṃ viruddhaṃ yadiha bahuvidhandarśitaṃ sūtrakāraistasmādatraikaśāstryaṃ haṭhakṛtamiti na brāhṛsaṃvādadāḍharāt| tannastātparyabhedairvihatiparihmatiḥ kāṇḍavatkāṇḍayossyāt bāhrākṣepārthagūḍhāśayavacanabhavadbhrāntiśāntyādisiddheḥ|| ākṣipya sthāpanīyāḥ katicidiha nayāḥ pūrvakāṇḍapraṇītāḥ kecidvyutpādanīyāḥ kvacidapavadanaṃ khyāpyamautsargikasya| itthaṃ sarvatra cintākrama iti samatāṃ vīkṣya madhyasthadṛṣṭā śāśtraikye paunaruktyaprabhṛtiparihmatissāvadhānairvibhāvyā|| vṛttigranthe tu jaiminyuparacitatayā ṣoḍaśādhyāyyupāttā saṅkarṣaḥ kāśakṛtsnaprabhava iti kathaṃ tatvaratnākaroktiḥ | atra brāūmassaduktau na vayamiha mudhā bādhituṃ kiñcidarhāḥ nirvāhastūpacārāt kvacidiha ghaṭate hrekatātparyayogaḥ|| sautrī saṅkhyā śubhāśīradhikṛtigaṇanā cinmayī brāhṛkāṇḍe tādathrye'nantaratve'pyadhikaraṇabhidā nālpasāraiḥ prakalpyā| akṣomryāśāhikāṣṭhādviradamunivasūmryardritattvātiśakvarya kṣairakṣaiḥ prayājairiha bhavati rasaiḥ pādanītiprabandhaḥ|| śāstraṃ tvetatsamanvityavihatikaraṇaprāpticintāpradhānairaddhyāyaiṣṣoḍaśāṅghridvikayugabhiduraṃ ṣaṭkabhedādinītyā| tatrādyaṃ vakti siddhaṃ viṣayamapi parantatpratidvandviyugmaṃ svaprāptessādhanaṃ ca svayamiti hi paraṃ brāhṛ tatrāpi cintyam|| tatrādye'tyantagūḍhāviśadaviśadasuspaṣṭajīvādivācaḥ paścātsmṛtyādikairakṣatirahitahatiḥ kāryatābhrendriyādeḥ| doṣādoṣau tṛtīye bhavabhṛditarayorbhaktiraṅgāni cāthopāsārohaprabhāvotkramasaraṇiphalānyantime cintitāni|| ruāṣṭā dehī svaniṣṭho niravadhimahimā'pāstabādhaḥ śritāptaḥ khātmāderindriyāderucitajananakṛtsaṃsṝtau tantravāhī| nirdoṣatvādiramyo bahubhajanapadaṃ svārhakarmaprasādyaḥ pāpacchidbrāhṛnāḍīgatikṛdativahan sāmyadaścātra vedyaḥ|| vidhyuktyā'dhītya vedānvidhibalaviratāvanyajādeva rāgāt kṛtsnaṃ mīmāṃsamānāḥ kramata iti parabrāhṛcintāntaranti| prāpte turye yuge'smin parimitabaladhīprāṇatadvighnadṛṣṭā kālakṣepākṣamatvāt katicana kṛtinaśśīghramante ramante|| rāgānmīmāṃsate cet svayamiha yatatāṃ kiṃ gurūktyeti cenna brāhṛjñānāptaye gurvabhigamanavidhestena tattvopadeśāt| sadvidyācāryavattve prathayati ca parabrāhṛvittintathānyāpyācāryādityadhīte niyamavidhirasau niścito nītividbhiḥ|| siddhe vyutpattirādyā na bhavati na ca dhīrlakṣaṇādyujyate'smin kiṃ śāstreṇānyasiddhe na ca niśamayitussiddhabodhe phalaṃ syāt| brāhṛṇyevanna mānānyupaniṣada iti stambhite tadvicāre śāstrārambhaṃ catussūtryaghaṭayaducitainryāyabhedaiścaturbhiḥ|| siddhe vyutpattyabhāve svariva phalatayā lakṣmabhaṅge ca labhyaṃ brāhṛānyoktyā'numānapramitamapi bhavatvaṃśataśśāstravedyam| vidhyarthatve'pyabādhāt paraviṣayavacassvārthamānaṃ bhavedityanvāruhroktidainyanna hi sahata ṛjussūtrakṛdvāvadūkaḥ|| dvābhyāmādau pratītiprajananamuditaṃ siddharūpe parasmin dvābhyāṃ vaiphalyaśaṅkā tadanu parihmatā śāstratajjanyabuddhyoḥ| aucityānekabhāṣyasvarasagatimatī prāktanī vartanīyaṃ śāstrārambhārthamekaṃ tritayamapi paraṃ śāstramityāhureke|| yattatseneśvarāryairagaṇi vakulabhṛtkiṅkarairaṅgyakāri vyāsāryainryāsi ca dviśśrutamiti viśadaṃ viṣṇucittairvivavre| aśrauṣaṃ śeṣakalpādahamapi viduṣo vādihaṃsāmbuvāhāt addhā nidrdhāryate'taścaturadhikaraṇī brāhṛcintopayuktā|| vyutkramyātrādyaturyāvabhidadhati nayau kecidaprāptametat bodhāsiddhau kathaṃ tatphalamiha vimṛśet siddhavatkāramāndyāt| madhyau dvau rūpanāmaprajananaviṣayau yadvidustacca mandaṃ satyukte'pekṣite'rthe viphalavibhajanaṃ nocitaṃ nītisūtre|| iti śāstrāvatāraḥ kārye vyutpattirādyā niyatamiti girastatparā eva sarvā nānyā vede'pi nītistata upaniṣadāmūṣaraprāyataiva| nātastadvedyamīmāṃsanamucitamiti pratyavasthīyamāne siddhe vyutpattimādyāṃ bahumukhamavayan brāhṛ jijñāsyamāha|| aṅgulyā nirdiśantaḥ kimapikimapi tadvācakāṃśaiḥ prayuktaiḥ bālān vyutpādayanti kramabhavamilitajñāpakatvaṃ vidantaḥ| saṅghātāste padānāṃ vidadhati ca dhiyaṃ kvāpi siddhe viśiṣṭe kartavye kvāpi ceti kvacidiha niyatiśśabdaśakterna kalpyā || saṃsāre'nādisiddhe muhuranubhavatassañcitāssaṃskriyāssyussaṃskārodbodhakāśca svayamupanipatantyaprakampyātpravāhāt| tattajjātīyabhedagrahaṇasamucitā vṛttayastannidānāḥ tadvatsyācchikṣakādivyavahmatiṣu śiśoraidamathryādibodhaḥ|| dakṣairādhoraṇādyairanumitavividhasvaprayāsopayogaiḥ śikṣābhedā vicitrā gajavihagamukhān grāhayadbhiḥ prayuktāḥ| tasmātsārthā manuṣyaprabhṛtiṣu ca tathābhūtaśikṣāviśeṣaḥ kalpo bhāṣyodito yanna yadi kathamasau kalpate'nyo'pi mārgaḥ|| kasmaicitsiddhamarthaṃ kamapi kathayituṃ ceṣṭayā codyamānaḥ tasmai taṃ vakti taddhīsamaviṣayatayā śikṣate tadvaco'nyaḥ| ādiṣṭo bodhanārthaṃ yadiha vitanute tattadarthaṃ hi yuktaṃ tadvākyātsiddhavedī prayatata iti cedastvanādeśikantat|| putraste'bhūnna sarpo'yamiti vacanataḥ prītyabhītyādiliṅgaiḥ tadyogyārthantadūhraṃ viṣayaniyatirāsaktipūrvaiḥ kvacitsyāt| āvāpodvāpabhedāt pratipadaniyatā śaktirapyatra siddhyet bhūyodṛṣṭādisāhāyyakamiha vacasaḥ kāryapakṣāviśiṣṭam|| kārye vyutpattirādyā bhavatu tadapi kiṃ śaktitātparyasiddheḥ prāgvyutpattiḥ kriyāyāṃ nṛvacasi nigame tvanyathetyabhyupaiṣi| sthāpyā'to'nanyathāsiddhyanugamaniyataissatprayogairhi śaktiḥ ko'sau pāñcāla ityādyucitaviratikaṃ siddhamātre'pi vākyam|| duḥkhāsaṃbhinnadeśaprabhṛtiphalatayā codanāsveva siddhaṃ śrautatvādārthavādikyapi bhavatu phalaṃ rātrisatre pratiṣṭhā| aṅgīkurmo niṣedhānuguṇamiti tathā'narthakṛttvaṃ niṣeddhye viddhyarthairapyatassyādavitathaviṣayā brāhṛdhīrarthavādaiḥ|| || iti jijñāsādhikaraṇam || janmādyaiścedviśeṣyaṃ bhavati bahulatā'thopalakṣyaṃ brāvīṣi jñātājñātādidauḥsthyaṃ vyatiṣajati na cālakṣite syātparīkṣā| uddiṣṭabrāhṛcintā tata iha kathamityatra hetutvalakṣyaḥ puṃsūktādiprasiddho guṇanidhiraghajidbrāśabdārtha uktaḥ|| nānā cellakṣaṇāni svarasabhiduratā brāhṛṇi syādviśeṣye khaṇḍo muṇḍaśca gaurityabhilapanasamā dharmiśabdaikatā'tra| teṣvekaṃ cedyathā'nyatsamuditamaphalaṃ syādvyavacchedyahāneḥ khaṇḍatvādikramāccetyasadavihatitaḥ khaṇḍatāderviśeṣāt|| tattatsvapratyanīkavyudasananiyataṃ bhedakaṃ nānyabādhi vyāghātaḥ kālabhedānna bhavati jananasthāpanadhvaṃsanānām| pratyekaṃ lakṣaṇatvaṃ suvacamiha bahūdāhmatirdhīmahimne saṃbhūyāpyāhureke phalamapi ca tadāśaṅkitārthavyudāsaḥ|| jñātaṃ cennopalakṣyanna ca yadi natarāṃ lakṣmayogāpratīteḥ jñātājñātāṃśabhedasviha durabhilapo lakṣaṇenaiva vedye| brāhṛtvaṃ brāhṛśabdānvitirapi vidite'nyatra nocenna śaṅkā maivannānāgamodyadviśayaśamanataḥ śrīmati brāhṛtokteḥ|| yāvallakṣyāvabodhaṃ yadavagatirato lakṣaṇāttadviśeṣyaṃ yasyābodhe'pi paścādyadavagatiridaṃ syātkuto nopalakṣyam| tasmāddvedhāpi bhāṣye'numatiranucitetyāśayājñasya codyaṃ mokṣārthopāsyabhede hrubhayamapi samanveti vidyāvikalpāt|| candre śākheva śānte mahati taṭagataṃ lakṣaṇaṃ kāraṇatvaṃ satyajñānādivākyairapamṛditaguṇantadvibhātīti ḍimbhāḥ| ekatrārtho viśeṣye pratipadaniyatāvajryatattannimittadvārāvṛtiṃta padānāmiha viduraruṇādyuktivannyāyavṛddhāḥ|| vītāvītaprayogakramaniyatimatī kāryatā viśvametat sarvajñena prakiptaṃ gamayati viphalastvatra śāstrairvicāraḥ| ityunnītau laghutvādanumitivaśataḥ karmajaiśvaryayukto viśvāmitrādinītyā sphurati vibhumihāsūtrayacchāstravedyam|| kṣityādyaṃ kāryatādyaiḥ kaṭakamakuṭavat kartṛpūrvaṃ sa kartā siddhyedatrāṇvadṛṣṭaprabhṛtijanakadṛk sarvaśaktiśca maivam| śrotrādyaissaurabhādigrahaṇaruciriyantādṛśavyāptyabhāvāt sarvaṃ hetunna paśyet ghaṭakṛdiha na cākartṛtā tāvatā'sya|| kāryatvāt syādvivādāspadamidamakhilaṃ sarvavit kartṛpūrvaṃ yannaivantaddhi naivaṃ puruṣavaditi nānanyathāsiddhyabhāvāt| hetāvetādṛśātmanyavidurabhiduraṃ vyāptyasiddhyādidauḥsthyantadbhaṅge lakṣaṇānāmagaṇi gamanikā tattvamuktākalāpe|| yadyapyātmāntarāderanumitiranaghā liṅgabhedaistathā'pi pratyakṣavyāptiśailī na khalu śithilitā kutracitpakṣabhede| āmnāye tvadbhutoktirna bhavati vitathā tādṛśāptoktanītyā bādhābhāvādisāmyādvihatimati bhavellokavat gauṇatādiḥ|| nanvāmnāyapradhānāḥ kvacidanukathayantyasmadāderaśakyaiḥ kāryaiḥ kartā'numeyaḥ para iti tadabhipraitu janmādivākyam| tasmādīśānumānatyajanamanucitaṃ vaidikasyeti cenna kvāpyaucityopadeśādyata iti ca sadādyuktisiddhānuvādāt|| kartavye hrartha ukte niśamayitṛphalaṃ siddharūpe tu na syāt prītyā sāphalyaklṛptau vitathamapi vacaḥ kinna dṛṣṭantadartham| vidyārthatve'nyadṛṣṭerviṣayavadanṛtaṃ tat parīkṣyanna bhāvītyākṣepe'nanyaśeṣe niravadhikasukhe śāstratātparyamāha|| tātparyaṃ brāhṛtattve'pyavihivīdhinā'pyekavākyatvapakṣe bhede'pi syādasiddherna bhavati balibhugdantasaṅkhyoktisāmyam| svādārthatvaṃ mṛṣātvakṣamamiti na mṛṣetyūhane prītyayogādvālopacchandanādiṣvapi viṣayatathābhāvabuddhyaiva harṣaḥ|| yatprītyarthaṃ vacastannikhilamanṛtamityarbhakaprāyavākyaṃ satyoktyānandadṛṣṭerna ca vihatirihāddhyakṣataśśāstrato vā| tenānanyārthasiddhoktyanṛtaviṣayatāśaṅkanastambhanena trayyantāssatyanityādbhutaparamaparabrāhṛniṣṭhāḥ pramāṇam|| brāhṛaike niṣprapañcīkaraṇavidhipadaṃ dhyānavidhyarthamanye nirdharmādvaitavākyopacaritamitare sidhyatīti brāuvanti| teṣāmeṣāṃ svapakṣasvavacanavihativyākulānekajalpāḥ kalpo'yaṃ bāhrakalpaḥ kṛtamatipariṣatpīṭhamardairamardi|| anyārtho hrarthavādasstutimukhamukhataḥ sthāpitaḥ prāgidānīṃ svātantryeṇa pramāṇīkriyata iti tataḥ kāṇḍayossyādvirodhaḥ| na syātsāmānyato hi prathamamabhidadhe mānatāsthāpanārthaṃ keṣāṃcitsvārthatoktā svata iha subhage bodhamātrātpumarthe|| tredhā sarvatra vede niyatavibhajane codanādyaṃśabhedaiścatvāro'pyarthavādā munibhirabhihitā brāāhṛṇāṃśasya śeṣāḥ| atrātaccheṣatoktau smṛtihatiriti cedviddhi dattottarantat sāmānyoktirhi seyaṃ tata upari yathāmantravidhyanyatokteḥ|| āmnātairaihikārthairaviguṇasaphalaiśśākunajyautiṣādyaiḥ pāratrikyā pravṛttyā'pyatinipuṇadhiyāmāgamāśvāsasiddhau| śabde tasmācca bodhe sati paraviṣaye doṣabādhavyapete mānaṃ tatra svato'sau na kathamitarathā naigamādhvāpalāpaḥ|| śāstrārambhopapattyai caturadhikaraṇī peṭikeyaṃ pravṛttā lakṣyasyoktaṃ viśeṣadvayamiha ghaṭate vakṣyamāṇopajīvi| sadbrāhṛādyuktivedyaḥ para iti hi vadetkāraṇatvādhikāre vakṣyatyasya dviliṅgādyadhikṛtiṣu punastādṛśānandatādīn|| ātmanyevaṃ parasminna kṛta iti mite viśvahetutvalakṣye śāstraikasthāpanīye nirupadhiparamapremayogye prasakte| īdṛktvaṃ syādyathārhaṃ prakṛtipuruṣayornānumānādyayogyau duḥkhāspṛṣṭau ca tāvityatha parakathanaṃ dodhavīti krameṇa|| gauṇekṣāsāhacaryānna tu bahubhavanaprekṣaṇaṃ naiva mukhyaṃ dṛṣṭāntādyairihābhātyanumitiracitastādṛśājjanma yuktam| sacchabdastena mūlaprakṛtimavikṛtiṃ vyāharedityayuktaṃ śrutyā'nyeṣāṃ nirodhāttvadabhimatatiraskāriliṅgādibhiśca|| jñāte hrekatra sarvaṃ viditamiti bhavatyaikyasiddhyai pratijñā mṛttatkāryādayaśca traya iha kathitāstasya dṛṣṭāntabhedāḥ| tenāvyāktānumānaṃ kathitamiti vṛthotkaṇṭhitaṃ hetvanuktessārūpyādeśca hetorupari parihmateratra saṃbhāvanokteḥ|| ādeśātmasvaśabdairaniyataśaraṇaistvantadaikyopadeśājjīvena svena sāhaṃkaraṇamanahamo'cidgaṇasya praveśāt| ekajñānena sarvaṃ viditamiti girā sarvatādātmyavācā śākhāvidyāntarāderapi bahubhavitā viśvavidviśvamūrtiḥ|| mukhyekṣā yadyabhīṣṭā bhavatu taducite sā punarjīvatattve sadvidyāyāṃ hi śabdaistribhirupari satastasya jīvaikyamuktam| ityūhādujjihānaṃ praśamayitumatha prastuto viśvakarmā jīvasyāpyantarātmā nirupadhikamahānandathussthāpyate'tra|| dṛṣṭaḥ pūrvaṃ vikāre mayaḍiti carame'pyevamastvityayuktaṃ madhye tadanayorbhedabhānāṃśa iṣṭaḥ siddhe dehātmabhāve tviha nahi ghaṭate tatsvaniṣṭhatvadṛṣṭiḥ|| mantroktaṃ bhoktṛbhāve yadi sahabhavanaṃ brāhṛ na syāt pradhānaṃ tasmāttadbhogyabhāve bhavatu taducite brāāhṛṇavyākṛteśca| dvedhāpi brāhṛ tattvāt pṛthagitara iha syāditīdañca vārtaṃ siddhe bhede svaniṣṭhasthitipariharaṇaṃ hratra sūtropapādyam || pāramyaṃ yacca sāmye śrutamiha nahi tatsarvathetyapyadhītaṃ grāvṇo hemnaśca yadvatsamadharaṇadhṛtau syāttaduktistathātra| evaṃ taddehabhāve sthitavati vividhābādhitāmnāyabhūmnā brāhṛaivetyādivākyaṃ prathayati samatāṃ tādṛgityapyadhīteḥ|| jñānatve kiṃ phalaṃ syāditi miṣatu guṇaistādṛśaṃ brāhṛsāmyaṃ kiṃ dharmairasvarūpaistadiha bhavatu cinmātrarūpaprakāśaḥ| itthaṃ chātroktapakṣadvayamubhayavidhaśrutyupāttādvirodhāt nirdhūyātha dvidhāvirbhavanamaghaṭayatsiddhatattvaprakāśāt|| paryāyau nāmapāṭheṣvanuparipaṭhitau muktikaivalyaśabdau kaivalyañcānyayogatyajanamiti kathaṃ dharmidharmānvayo'sya| maivaṃ brāhṛsvarūpādaparamiha na khalvasti kiñcit svaniṣṭhaṃ na dravyañcāguṇaṃ syādadhikaraṇayugaṃ tannirātaṅkametat|| dhātrāderapyapekṣyo hrupakaraṇagaṇassatyasaṅkalpavṛtteḥ muktasyāpyevamevāstviti yadi vitathaṃ tadvikalpāsahatvāt| iṣṭā dravyādyapekṣā sukṛtataditarāpekṣaṇaṃ tatra dussthaṃ na syādicchāvighātastvanupadhikatayā devavāñchaikarasyāt|| viśvasyaitasya janmasthitilayaracanā viśvakarturyathā syāt icchāsantānabhedānniyatiriha tathā nityamuktakriyāṇām| tasyānucchedavṛttyā pratikalabhidurāstāśca tādṛkpravāhāḥ tadbuddherāparokṣyaṃ tvaniśamabhiduraṃ vartate brāhṛdhīvat|| pratyūhārhaḥ prajeśaprabhṛtisukṛtināṃ satyasaṅkalpabhāvo matryārambhaspṛhādau taditaravividhaprāṇisṛṣṭādidṛṣṭeḥ| tenecchāsantatīnāṃ saphalaviphalate puṇyapāpairamīṣāṃ muktasyoktā cikīrṣā tvavihataviṣayā tāratamyaṃ na doṣaḥ|| sūtre mukto'pyananyādhipatirabhihitastena kastasya śeṣī śrutyaivoktassvarāḍityapi vihatirataḥ prākpratiṣṭhāpitānām| maivaṃ nāthetarānpratyaghavihita iha kṣipyate śeṣabhāvo viśvasyātmeśvaro yaḥ patiriti paṭhitastatpatitvaṃ tvabādhyam|| muktaḥ prokto'śarīraḥ kvacidatha bahudhā saṃbhavaḥ kvāpyadhīto gānakrīḍādi coktaṃ tadanuguṇamatadvandvamārṣaṃ nirasyan| svacchandasyobhayaṃ tatkṣamamiti vadati svaṃ mataṃ sūtrakāraḥ syāccākarmodbhavaṃ tannikhilamapi parabrāhṛvattatsamasya|| mokṣe puṇyādyabhāvāttadupadhikavapurvarjitatvaṃ na dūṣyaṃ tasminduḥkhārhadehatyaji ca śubhavapussattvapakṣo'pyabādhyaḥ| itthaṃ satyatra muktasthitiriha muninā kīdṛśī sūtritā syāt naivaṃ svacchandadehagrahatadaniyamasthāpane'trābhisandheḥ|| nānādehā yadi syuryugapadadhigatabrāhṛsāmyasya puṃsaḥ teṣāṃ vyāptasvarūpānvaya ucita iti prāktanāṇutvahānam| naitaddhīvyāptisiddherbhavati ca jagadāveśavāk tannidānā saubharyādau praklṛptāṃ gatimapavadituṃ na kṣamaṃ brāhṛsāmyam|| dehānāṃ yaugapadye bahuṣu kathamaṇurdhārako'stveṣa muktaḥ caitanyadvārataścet sakalamapi sadā dhārayedvyāptabodhaḥ| maivaṃ muktasya śaktirniyamitaviṣayā tvicchayā sarvaśakteḥ prāktādṛgyogaśaktyā bahutanubhajane karmabandho'pyapekṣyaḥ|| śaktiḥ kṣetrajñasaṃjñā munibhirabhidadhe veṣṭitā karmabhissvaiḥ puṃso'naṃśāpi buddhirbahuvidhavikṛtissvīkṛtaivaṃ sa cāstu| vālāgretyādivākyāttadayamaṇurapi syādananto'pi muktau na syājjainādibhaṅge parihmatavikṛteraikarūpyānapāyāt|| jīvasyaikekaśo hi tyajanata udito vṛkṣaśākhāsu śoṣaḥ tasmādadvārakaṃ syādapagatavaraṇe mukhyamānantyamasmin | maivaṃ śākhāsu bhogāśrayaniyatikaropādhināśaḥ prahāṇaṃ kṣetrādinyāyato'sāvabhimativirahāt syādadhīto jahātiḥ|| eko naikaḥ parasmāt pṛthagapṛthagapi svasvarūpeṇa muktaḥ svābhīṣṭāśeṣabhoktā svayamiti pṛthukakṣībacodye bhramanti| te'nvīkṣya svoktibādhaṃ śrutiśatavihatiṃ tattaduktyānyaparyāt jaināvaṣṭambhadṛpyanmatikalahamucassatpathaṃ saṃśrayantu|| sarvaṃ saṃkalpamātrāllabhata iti samāmnāyate sūtritañca svecchāto dehayogādyaniyatikathanaṃ syādataḥ piṣṭapeṣaḥ| tannānyonyoparuddhaśrutigatiniyatiḥ kāmato'nekadehasvīkāraprakriyetyādyaniyatikathane sūtrakārābhisandheḥ|| yadyapyukto vimuktaḥ paratanurapṛthaksiddha ityatra pūrvaṃ vyāpārāṃśe tathāpi śrutamiha paramaṃ sāmyamakṣobhaṇīyam| saṃkalpādeva sarvotthitirapi hi tatassyāditi pratyavasthāṃ kṛntatyante'dhikāre kṛtimaditarayossthāpayanbhogasāmyam|| sāyujyaṃ bhogasāmyaṃ samagaṇi nipuṇaiśśabdaśaktyādyabādhāt tacca vyāpārasāmye tvasati na ghaṭate svakriyāsvādahāneḥ| tasmānmuktasya sṛṣṭiprabhṛtirapi jagadvyāpṛtibrrāhṛtulyā maivaṃ tallakṣaṇaṃ sā kathamanugamatastasya cānyasya ca syāt|| kathyante sṛṣṭivākye kvacidapi na jagatkāraṇatvena muktāḥ prādhītaḥ kāmacāro bhavatu na jagadārambhakatvaṃ tatassyāt| sarvākāropabhogyeśvaraviṣayadhiyassāmyato bhogasāmyaṃ yujyetānandavallyāṃ samagaṇi vibhunānandamātre samatvam|| niṣkāmaśrotriyasyāpyatidiśati sukhaṃ mānuṣānandatulyaṃ sānandānvaktukāmā śataguṇamadhikānāviriñcaṃ krameṇa| tattadbhogātprathiṣṭhaṃ kathamidamavaraṃ kaṣṭamiṣṭaṃ ca mukte satyaṃ tat syānmukundapriyajanasadṛśe hrekadeśānuvādaḥ|| ānandānantyamāha śrutiriha hi yato vāca ityādikāsyāḥ viśrāntiśśrāntimātrāditi ca nigaditā yāmunācāryavaryaiḥ| na hrānandonmitissyādvidhiśatavacane'pyasya yaṣṭā nabhovat taccoktaṃ bhūdharāṇvorudadhipatitayormajjane ko viśeṣaḥ|| viśvaṃ muktasya deho nakhalu tadapṛthaksiddhyabhāvopalambhāt nopādānaṃ tato'sau kathayitumucitassarvaśaktitvahāneḥ| nātmāśakyaṃ cikīrṣettaditaraviṣaye nirvighātā tadicchā vyāpāre bhidyamāne'pyaviṣamarasatā dṛśyate kvāpi loke|| tattatsevāviśeṣasthirapariṇamitassārvabhaumaprasādaḥ sūte bhṛtyasya sāmyaṃ svayamanabhimatasvāmicihnaikavarjam| evaṃ devaṃ dayāluṃ śaraṇamupagatairlabhyate'nanyalabhyā nirdhūtāvṛttiśaṅkā nirupadhikarasā savyavasthā tvavasthā|| atrāhussūtramantyaṃ pṛthagadhikaraṇaṃ kecidāñjasyalābhāt astyāvṛttinirṣedhye tvimamiti hi padaṃ tena śaṅkotthiteti| bhāṣyādau tanna dṛṣṭaṃ bhavati ca sugamaṃ pūrvaśeṣatvamasya syādāvṛttiprasaṅgādapi nikhilajagannirmitau sāmyaśaṅkā|| sargādyāvartalīlārasasahacarite daṇḍarāse niyuktaṃ jīvaṃ devo vimucya kramata iti sayugbhāvadhanyaṃ bhunakti | karmātyantopaśānteriha naca punarāvartayatyenamityapyāmnāteḥ karmamūlākṣayaphalakathanādyutthaśaṅkopaśāntiḥ|| svāvirbhāvo'pavarge nirupadhiniyatasvaprakāryantadṛṣṭiḥ cidrūpasyaiva tadvacchatimakuṭamitaissvaprakāraissahekṣā| saṅkalpādeva siddhistadanu ca niyamonmuktatā brāhṛsāmyaprāptau tallakṣaṇāṃśojjhanamiti caramādhyāyaturyāṅghrisārāḥ|| dhyānādiṃ tatprabhāvaṃ karaṇabhṛta ito dehakārākuṭīrāt niṣkrānta brāhṛnāḍā gatimapi supathā svaprakāśañca sādhyam| icchātassveṣṭasṛṣṭa paramamapi parabrāhṛṇā bhogamātre sāmyaṃ māyāmatasthaḥ kathamiva ghaṭayedantimādhyāyasāram|| mānāmānaprabhedaprabhṛtivibhajanādādime karmabhāge nānā vā devatetyādyanupadapaṭhanānmadhyame devatāṃśe| bhāge'sminbhedadharmaprabhṛtikathanatassaugatādeśca bhaṅgāt mīmāṃsāyāstrikāṇḍāṃ kvacidapi na mṛṣāvādagandhāvakāśaḥ|| trayyantodanvadantassṛtiriyamuditā deśikaiḥ karṇadhāraiḥ tattvārthajñānapāraṃ gamayati viśadaṃ tvanyadīkṣyaṃ vimuktau| kartavye kalpakāraiḥ kvacidabhidadhire kṛtyasandehabhedāḥ tattve'pyevaṃ kvacitsyāttadapi na vitathassvopayuktāṃśabodhaḥ|| śrutyantaikāntatarkakramagarimadhṛtau tūlavacchailavargaḥ tatsiddhabrāhṛbodhadyumaṇiruci tamasstomakalpo'nyajalpaḥ| mokṣopāyaikarājye tīvraniṣpannarāgaḥ| kañcidvidyāviśeṣaṃ saparikaramadhiṣṭhāya śāntāntarāyaḥ sampadya brāhṛ bhuṅkte nirupadhikamanāvṛttiritthaṃ śrutārthaḥ|| sāsau sāsūyatattatkumatimatasamunmūlanī mūlanītiśreṇīniśśreṇikalpā triyugapatharathārohasūtaṃ suvīta| santassantāpavargapraśamanapaṭunā tattvabodhena santaṃ santoṣaṃ brāhṛsūtrādhikaraṇacaraṇādhyāyasārāvalirvaḥ|| vayamiha mudhā kurmahe narmahelām|| viśvaṃ dravyādibhedādviśadamabhihitaṃ tattvamuktākalāpe vyūḍhaṃ śārīrakasya tviha dṛḍhaghaṭitaṃ rūpamāpādacūḍam| tasmādasmācchatābdheramṛtamiva samudvāntamaśrāntabaddhaśraddhairanyonyahastapradamidamubhayaṃ dhāryamācāryavadbhiḥ|| itthaṃ śārīrakokte pathi samupanatāsruāgdharāśśraddadhānaṃ pāre māyāpayodheḥ prahitamabhimukhaissūribhiśśuddhabhāvaiḥ| brāhṛālaṅkārakalpairbahubhirupaniṣatsūtratātparyaśilpaiḥ devārhatvāya divyāpsarasa iva pariṣkṛtya sambhāvayanti|| prajñādhammillamallīparimalamilitaprājñasevāsamudyacchuddhālokojjvalaṃ māṃ śrutipariṣadupaskārisaubhāgyavadbhiḥ| padyairetaissvahmadyaiḥ praṇavamahimavatpāñcajanyakrameṇa svādhmātaṃ
